ExtractedFactNoCausal.description: A single extracted fact WITHOUT causal relations (for when causal extraction is disabled).

what.description: WHAT happened - COMPLETE, DETAILED description with ALL specifics.
what.title: What

when.description: WHEN it happened - include temporal information if mentioned.
when.title: When

where.description: WHERE it happened - SPECIFIC locations if applicable.
where.title: Where

who.description: WHO is involved - ALL people/entities with relationships.
who.title: Who

why.description: WHY it matters - emotional, contextual, and motivational details.
why.title: Why

fact_type.description: 'world' = about the user/others, including user preferences, rules, corrections, and constraints. 'assistant' = actions or experiences the assistant/agent actually performed.
fact_type.title: Fact Type

entities.description: Named entities, objects, and concepts from the fact, as plain strings (e.g. ["Alice", "Kubernetes"]).
entities.title: Entities

from_attachments.description: Numbers of the attachments this fact's information came from, as listed under ATTACHMENTS. Leave empty for facts drawn from the surrounding text. Only list an attachment when the fact could not be stated without looking at it.
from_attachments.title: From Attachments
